description:
The Bacchetta Pronto Alto is the newest bike in our line of electric assist recumbnts! Based on the popular Giro A26 and Corsa A70, the Alto gets you there with speed and comfort. And like all Bacchetta recumbents, you can customize the bike to meet your specific riding style.
The classic Bacchetta Giro A26 is built for someone who wants a classic touring/recreational recumbent bike with a little more speed. The lighter A70 with larger wheels is a dedicated speed machine! Whether planning a tour across the country or enjoying a fast ride with friends, the Bacchetta high racer will ensure that you get there fast and in comfort. The Pronto Alto adds the silent and buttery-smooth Bafang M510 mid-drive electric assist system to give you a little more "umph" to get up to speed or climb those steeper climbs. 250w and 95Nm of torque provide more than enough power for all of your riding needs. The 17.5Ah battery will keep you going on rides up to 60 miles (depending on terrain, power usage and total weight). This "no throttle" system senses the torque you apply while pedaling to ensure a smooth, natural-feeling ride. And with all the cables routed internally, you maintain the sleek look of your favorite bike!
The Bacchetta Pronto Alto features top-notch component options including Velocity USA’s Aileron handbuilt wheels, a SRAM 11 speed drivetrain with smooth-as-silk grip shifters or the bomb-proof, world-reknown Rohloff Speedhub, and TRP Spyre brakes for exceptional stopping power. Choose your seat - for those that want comfort in the most upright position, choose the classic Recurve seat. If you want to recline a little more and save 1.5 pounds at the same time, the B3 seat will work perfectly for you. If you want even more recline, choose the Euromesh seat with your choice of seat pad and save an additional one pound.
Our new custom paint program allows you to choose from one of our five standard colors or upgrade to a color of your choice. Depending on the options and color you choose, it can take anywhere from 3-5 weeks to build your bike.
The Alto is available in two sizes - medium is designed for riders under 5’8”-5’11” while large is sized for riders 5’11” and taller. The bike as shown, size medium with a Euromesh seat, weighs 48 pounds.
- Medium frame, B3 seat - 42 - 47.5” exseam, 48 pounds
- Medium frame, Recurve seat - 43-49” exseam, 50 pounds
- Medium frame Euromesh seat -42-47.5” exseam, 47 pounds
- Large frame, B3 seat - 45 - 51” exseam, 49 pounds
- Large frame, Recurve seat - 46 - 52” exseam, 50.5 pounds
- Large frame, Euromesh seat -45 - 51” exseam, 48 pounds
Seat Height (mid position, 26" wheels, add 1" with 700c): Euromesh 25"
Bottom Bracket Height (26" wheels, add 1" with 700c): medium 33"
Bacchetta bikes can be loaded up with a variety of accessories to meet your riding needs. Carry up to two panniers with the Universal Rear Rack. Kickstands, fenders and mirrors are readily available. And for shorter day rides, Bacchetta offers a variety of bags.
We charge a flat rate of $369 for shipping via freight in the Continental US. UPS shipping to Hawaii and Alaska is also $369, but the bike is not fully assembled. Shipping to Canada is a flat $629, but does not include any duty and fees you may be charged.
The bike comes 99% fully assembled (Hawaii, Alaska and International excluded) - just install the front wheel and adjust the seat/handlebars to your liking. If you order additional parts with the bike, our website may charge you additional shipping.
A final note about ordering bikes on our website: We will always call you after you place your order to discuss your build, make sure all of the options are correct and ensure that it is the right bike for you. If we need to make changes, additions or cancellations, we will happily do that - we want to make sure you are happy with your new bike. We will NEVER just ship out a bike without a conversation. To check to see if you have a local dealer, check out our Bacchetta Dealer Locator page.
